page.layout: One page of running text, single column, with a catchword line at the foot right. No margin notes. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right.

main_text.p: Similiter & graue quippiam potētia graue est, & conatur actu quidem quoque tale fieri, id est, re ipsa deorsum descendere: sed quoniam sorte imposi-tum est excelsæ columnæ, aut simili rei, impeditur, nec potest prius deorsum tendere, quàm columna & omne impedimentum per aliquem remoueatur. Iam ex his licet colligere, quòd leuia sursum, grauia deorsum tendant, duabus id de causis euenire.
1. Quòd à primo generationis suæ tempore accepe-rint formam, secundum quam apta nata sunt, naturaliter sursum uel deorsum ferri.

2. Quòd adiuuentur ab eo quod remouet impedimentum, per quod prohibebantur, ne actu ferent huiusmodi. Prima causa est per se mouens, posterior per accidens. Itaq; mouentur quidem illa sic naturaliter, quandoquidem habent principium motus in seipsis, non tamen habent principium mouendi: hoc est, habent principium passiuum, at non actiuum. Quòd enim moueantur, quò per naturam tendunt, acceptum ferri ei debet, à quo remouetur impedimenta. Ergo grauia & leuia non mouetur à se ipsis, sed præcipuè à remouente impedimentum.
Probatum igitur abundè est, omne quod mouetur, ab alio mo-ueri.

page.notes: Catchword "Quo-" at lower right, partly visible. Show-through from the reverse page is faint in the lower half and was excluded. The "s" beside "k" at the foot is a signature-like mark and was treated as furniture; "k s" is possibly a gathering signature, shown here only in the main text as printed. Ligature "Quo" with a raised macron in "Quòd" and "Quo-" is a printed form and kept as printed. Some words in lines 3 and 5 of the second paragraph ("sursum", "illa") are clear but the printed pencil-like spot near "mouentur" was ignored.
